menu:507900036:1.text: Sweetheart, we're not open for business right now!
menu:507900036:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，现在可不是营业时间喔！

say:1:1322525001:1.text: I've been checking on the progress of the Whiteridge restoration. Honestly, it's not going too well, but I get it. Everyone's dealing with their own issues. The court is already working on it.
say:1:1322525001:1.source_cn: 我正在盘查白山的修复工作进度，似乎都不算理想……但我能...
say:1:1322525001:1.male: I've been checking on the progress of the Whiteridge restoration. Honestly, it's not going too well, but I get it. Everyone's dealing with their own issues. The court is already working on it.
say:1:1322525001:1.female: I've been checking on the progress of the Whiteridge restoration. Honestly, it's not going too well, but I get it. Everyone's dealing with their own issues. The court is already working on it.

say:2:1322525002:1.text: Magister, could you check on the repairs at the hot spring inn? I'm tied up at the moment.
say:2:1322525002:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，温泉旅馆那边能劳烦你过去看下修复进度吗？我...
say:2:1322525002:1.male: Magister, could you check on the repairs at the hot spring inn? I'm tied up at the moment.
say:2:1322525002:1.female: Magister, could you check on the repairs at the hot spring inn? I'm tied up at the moment.

say:3:1322525003:1.text: The villagers are hoping to get some well-deserved rest at the inn once the repairs are done. They've been asking about it.
say:3:1322525003:1.source_cn: 镇民们都很希望在修复工作结束后能好好休个假，泡个温泉放...
say:3:1322525003:1.male: The villagers are hoping to get some well-deserved rest at the inn once the repairs are done. They've been asking about it.
say:3:1322525003:1.female: The villagers are hoping to get some well-deserved rest at the inn once the repairs are done. They've been asking about it.

say:0:1322526001:0.source_cn: 主人，我看到工匠了！他在那！

say:1:1322527001:1.text: These little pests won't leave me alone! I can't get a minute of peace!
say:1:1322527001:1.source_cn: 这群吱吱哇哇的小混蛋在我耳边吵很久了！

say:2:1322527002:0.text: Hey, could you shoo them away for me? I can't focus on the repairs with all this noise!
say:2:1322527002:0.source_cn: 唉，我说……这位朋友，你能帮我赶走它们吗？没有安静的环...
say:2:1322527002:0.male: Hey, could you shoo them away for me? I can't focus on the repairs with all this noise!
say:2:1322527002:0.female: Hey, could you shoo them away for me? I can't focus on the repairs with all this noise!

say:1:1322528001:1.text: Ah, this peace and quiet is exactly what I needed! Now I can finally get back to work. Thanks a ton!
say:1:1322528001:1.source_cn: 此时此刻没什么比安静更让我心情愉悦！我终于能安心工作了...
say:1:1322528001:1.male: Ah, this peace and quiet is exactly what I needed! Now I can finally get back to work. Thanks a ton!
say:1:1322528001:1.female: Ah, this peace and quiet is exactly what I needed! Now I can finally get back to work. Thanks a ton!

say:2:1322528002:1.text: Don't worry about the progress! We will finish on time, even if the sky falls!
say:2:1322528002:1.source_cn: 进度放心！就算是天塌下来，矮人工匠也会按时交工的！

say:1:1322529001:1.text: This streetlamp keeps flashing in my face, it's blinding! Fixing this thing is a nightmare!
say:1:1322529001:1.source_cn: 这路灯一闪一闪的，快把我晃瞎了！修这玩意儿真是个又费力...

say:2:1322529002:1.text: Got time for a game of Century Quest? I need a break before I go blind from all this.
say:2:1322529002:1.source_cn: 你有空吗，咱们来盘百物牌？我得好好放松一下我的眼睛！
say:2:1322529002:1.male: Got time for a game of Century Quest? I need a break before I go blind from all this.
say:2:1322529002:1.female: Got time for a game of Century Quest? I need a break before I go blind from all this.

say:1:1322530001:1.text: Ahh, that feels so much better. My eyes are thanking me!
say:1:1322530001:1.source_cn: 这眼球转一转确实舒服多了！

say:2:1322530002:1.text: Thanks to you, the lamp should be fixed by tonight!
say:2:1322530002:1.source_cn: 多亏了你啊，电灯今晚前就能修好！
say:2:1322530002:1.male: Thanks to you, the lamp should be fixed by tonight!
say:2:1322530002:1.female: Thanks to you, the lamp should be fixed by tonight!

say:1:1322531001:1.text: Oh, you're checking on the progress? Everything's going fine. These craftsmen are working hard!
say:1:1322531001:1.source_cn: 原来你们是来关注进度的，放心！一切正常，这群工匠小伙子...

say:2:1322531002:1.text: We should be wrapping up soon. I was thinking of bringing them some local snacks as a thank you.
say:2:1322531002:1.source_cn: 不出意外的话，很快就会收工，我正想着给他们带点特产回去。

say:3:1322531003:1.text: But there's a lot, and the bags are too small. Could you give me a hand packing everything in?
say:3:1322531003:1.source_cn: 但是东西有点多，袋子却有些小。你能来帮帮忙，把这些礼物...
say:3:1322531003:1.male: But there's a lot, and the bags are too small. Could you give me a hand packing everything in?
say:3:1322531003:1.female: But there's a lot, and the bags are too small. Could you give me a hand packing everything in?

say:1:1322532001:1.text: How did you fit it all in there? That's incredible! Is that some kind of magic?
say:1:1322532001:1.source_cn: 你怎么放进去的！太神奇了！不会是魔法吧！
say:1:1322532001:1.male: How did you fit it all in there? That's incredible! Is that some kind of magic?
say:1:1322532001:1.female: How did you fit it all in there? That's incredible! Is that some kind of magic?

say:2:1322532002:1.text: Oh right, the progress is on track. No need to worry about it!
say:2:1322532002:1.source_cn: 噢对了，进度都正常，放心吧！

say:1:1322533001:1.text: Glad to hear everything is going great... That's a weight off my shoulders.
say:1:1322533001:1.source_cn: 进度正常……太好了，这下我不用担心了。
say:1:1322533001:1.male: Glad to hear everything is going great... That's a weight off my shoulders.
say:1:1322533001:1.female: Glad to hear everything is going great... That's a weight off my shoulders.

say:2:1322533002:1.text: Gerda's done an amazing job with the inn. She really knows what she's doing.
say:2:1322533002:1.source_cn: 能够将温泉旅馆经营得这样好，格尔达的能力果然是名不虚传的。
say:2:1322533002:1.male: Gerda's done an amazing job with the inn. She really knows what she's doing.
say:2:1322533002:1.female: Gerda's done an amazing job with the inn. She really knows what she's doing.

say:3:1322533003:1.text: Thanks for letting me know. This is great news, the villagers will be thrilled when they hear it.
say:3:1322533003:1.source_cn: 劳烦您跑一趟了，这是个很振奋人心的消息，镇民们知道了一...
say:3:1322533003:1.male: Thanks for letting me know. This is great news, the villagers will be thrilled when they hear it.
say:3:1322533003:1.female: Thanks for letting me know. This is great news, the villagers will be thrilled when they hear it.
